Responsibilities
The Lockheed Martin Rotary & Mission Systems Software Engineer will have the opportunity to perform real-time processing software development in support of our product lines
Additionally, you will be working as part of an Agile team with domain experts from Hardware, Software, Subsystems and Systems Engineering to understand requirements, establish architecture/design, implement sound solutions, develop unit tests, and support integration and sustainment activities

Experience developing system and software requirements and design

Experience with Agile Principles, Continuous Integration/ Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Methodologies and Agile configuration Management tools (Git, JIRA, Confluence)
Experience with working in containerized environments (Docker, Podman, etc.)

Experience/knowledge of radar control processing
